body.html: Among the accommodation options along Charan Sanitwong Road near Yanhee International Hospital, P-Park Hotel Bangkok is one of the very few that offers a genuine swimming pool and a gym — not just a bedroom. The hotel is at 683/2 Charan Sanitwong Road in the Bang Ao sub-district of Bang Phlat, roughly 700 metres from Yanhee's main gate. A Grab ride costs next to nothing. For anyone staying multiple nights — whether recovering from gender-affirming surgery, a cosmetic procedure, or simply waiting between appointments — having an on-site pool and fitness room makes a real difference to how the days feel.

The hotel has 30 rooms across four categories: Superior Double (one queen bed, ~20 sqm) · Superior Twin (two singles, ~20 sqm) · Deluxe Triple (~30 sqm, with a semi-separate single bedroom, good for a patient and one companion) · and Suite (~60 sqm, separate living room and bedroom). All rooms have air conditioning, a minibar, flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, and a tea and coffee maker. What comes up most in real reviews is the size and cleanliness — guests consistently say rooms are bigger than expected and spotlessly maintained, with a cleanliness score of 9.3 out of 10 across 137 reviews.
"The room was huge and very clean. Staff members Fah and June both speak good English and are genuinely kind — highly recommend for anyone coming to Yanhee."

The outdoor pool and gym are the main reason people choose this hotel over simpler guesthouses in the same area. For recovery patients who have been cleared by their doctor for light exercise, having a pool in the building is far more convenient than travelling elsewhere. The on-site restaurant serves Thai and American dishes and runs an affordable breakfast buffet that several reviewers mention positively. Free parking is a practical bonus for those arriving by car, and there is also a meeting room for groups coming together.

On transport, the nearest MRT is Bang O station, about 1 kilometre away — walkable if you're in good shape, but a quick Grab if you're not. The hotel's primary selling point is closeness to Yanhee, not proximity to metro-accessible Bangkok. The Charan Sanitwong corridor has convenience stores, pharmacies, local restaurants and food stalls within a short walk or ride, which is usually enough for guests focused on treatment and recovery. For sightseeing across the city, the MRT is a Grab away.

A score of 9.1 overall — with service at 9.4 and cleanliness at 9.3 — reflects that most guests leave satisfied. Service quality in particular stands out, which matters if you're unwell or managing a stressful medical journey. The honest note, though, is that some reviews flag maintenance issues in older rooms: peeling wallpaper, a broken fitting, or mould in a bathroom. These appear to be isolated rather than systemic, and multiple reviewers say the staff resolved problems quickly when raised — but it is worth checking your room carefully on arrival.

A tip from reading the reviews: if you're a patient travelling with a companion, the Deluxe Triple is a far better choice than two separate Superior rooms — more space, a partially private sleeping arrangement and still reasonable pricing. If you're planning a stay of a week or more, call the hotel directly (they list +66 288 55478 and +66 95 937 3030) to ask about extended-stay rates, which are not always published on booking platforms. And always phone ahead to confirm your room the day before you arrive, particularly when Yanhee's schedules are busy and the area's accommodation fills fast.

honestSummary: P-Park Hotel Bangkok delivers a swimming pool and gym in the closest viable position to Yanhee International Hospital — a combination that is genuinely rare in this stretch of Charan Sanitwong Road. Rooms are wide, clean and well-serviced. It works well for recovery patients, companions and anyone on an extended medical stay. The caveats are real: some rooms carry maintenance issues, it is not an MRT-friendly location, and it is not for visitors wanting to explore Bangkok.
honestChecks: If a pool near Yanhee is the priority — P-Park is the closest hotel in this area with a genuine pool → book early when Yanhee is busy, as there are only 30 rooms and they fill quickly

If the condition of your room matters greatly — inspect the room carefully the moment you receive your key; some reviews mention isolated maintenance issues → the staff respond well when problems are flagged

If you are visiting Bangkok as a tourist with no Yanhee appointment — this neighbourhood is far from the main sights and MRT is a ride away → choose a hotel closer to BTS or MRT in central Bangkok instead

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — P-Park Hotel Bangkok

faq.q: How far is P-Park Hotel Bangkok from Yanhee International Hospital?
faq.a: P-Park Hotel is at 683/2 Charan Sanitwong Road, Bang Ao, Bang Phlat, roughly 700 metres — about a 5-minute drive from Yanhee International Hospital's main entrance. A Grab costs next to nothing, or you can drive and use the hotel's free parking.

faq.q: Does P-Park Hotel Bangkok really have a swimming pool and gym?
faq.a: Yes — there is a genuine outdoor swimming pool and a fitness room, which is rare among hotels in the immediate Yanhee area. This is the main reason many medical travellers choose P-Park over simpler guesthouses nearby. Ideal for recovery patients who have been cleared for light exercise.

faq.q: How much does P-Park Hotel Bangkok cost and what room types are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around THB 850/night for a Superior Double (~20 sqm). Superior Twin is around THB 900, Deluxe Triple (~30 sqm) around THB 1,100, and the Suite (~60 sqm) around THB 1,400. Prices vary by season and are higher when Yanhee has heavy patient volume. Always compare platforms and ask the hotel directly about extended-stay rates.

faq.q: Is P-Park Hotel near an MRT or BTS station?
faq.a: The nearest MRT is Bang O station, about 1 kilometre away — too far to walk comfortably for a recovery patient, but a short Grab ride. This hotel is best suited to guests who drive their own car (free parking is available) or rely on Grab. It is not a hotel for people planning to sightsee Bangkok via public transit every day.

faq.q: Is P-Park Hotel Bangkok suitable for post-surgery recovery at Yanhee?
faq.a: Yes, it is well suited for recovery stays following cosmetic surgery or gender-affirming procedures at Yanhee. The combination of pool, gym, on-site restaurant, free parking and just 700 m to the hospital makes it one of the most practical choices in the area. For patients with a companion, the Deluxe Triple offers a semi-private sleeping arrangement. Ask for a low-floor room if mobility is limited after surgery.

faq.q: Does P-Park Hotel Bangkok offer monthly or long-stay rates?
faq.a: Extended-stay pricing is not typically listed on online booking platforms. Call the hotel directly at +66 288 55478 or +66 95 937 3030 to ask about weekly or monthly rates, especially for post-surgical recovery stays of seven nights or more. A direct rate is often better than what is shown online.
